statement: When I'm off the clock, I'm usually scheming through a Mafia round, marathoning a series with friends, or out with a camera.

pursuits.title: Mind Games & Mafia
pursuits.body: Mafia, puzzles, and party games that reward reading the room. Monopoly Deal and Uno No Mercy are weekend staples.

pursuits.title: Valorant with Friends
pursuits.body: Casual ranked nights with friends — five-stack chaos, post-match recaps, occasionally an actual win.

pursuits.title: LeetCode, Lightly
pursuits.body: Not chasing rating anymore — a few problems a week to keep the data-structures muscle warm.

pursuits.title: TV & Cinema
pursuits.body: MCU through Phase 4, lifelong Batman + DC fan (Peacemaker was a treat), GOT and House of the Dragon for the long haul. Sitcoms on rotation: The Office, B99, HIMYM, Big Bang Theory.

pursuits.title: Photography
pursuits.body: Old habit, slowly returning. Mostly street and travel — happy to share a few frames below.
